name: media-gen
description: Generate images, music, speech and video through OpenRouter on your own key. Asks before it starts spending, and tells you what each generation cost.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: From https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys. Kept in your system keychain; Claude never sees it. Safest: a key made just for this, with a spend limit.
